swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: OPA2333AIDR is limited to 5.5 V max (7 V abs max, p.5) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 6.3x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.35 MHz p.7); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 6.3x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.16 V/µs p.7); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
CAUTION PRECISION OFFSET SHIFT: Maximum Vos differs by 800x (MC33202DR2G: 8 mV p.3 vs OPA2333AIDR: 0.01 mV p.7); high-gain DC sensor stages may lose accuracy or require zero-drift chopper filtering.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 1143x (MC33202DR2G: 80000 pA p.3 vs OPA2333AIDR: 70 pA p.7); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 52.9x (MC33202DR2G: 900 µA/ch p.4 vs OPA2333AIDR: 17 µA/ch p.7); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: OPA2333AIDR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (7 V, p.5) than MC33202DR2G (13 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 7 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 53% higher on MC33202DR2G (MC33202DR2G: 190 °C/W p.5 vs OPA2333AIDR: 124 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs OPA2333AIDR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 125°C)); MC33202DR2G hot limit only 105 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and OPA2333AIDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; GBWP differs 6.3x; slew rate differs 6.3x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 0.35 MHz (p.7), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 5.5 V (p.5), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 0.01 mV (p.7), Ib 1143x gap (80000 vs 70 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and OPA2333AIDR "Weak ±5 mA Output Drive and 350 kHz / 0.16 V/µs Speed vs Pin-Identical TLV9002/TLV9062/LMV358" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when supply rails exceed 5.5 V (rated up to 12 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 2.2 MHz GBWP; choose OPA2333AIDR when DC precision demands <= 0.01 mV max Vos or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (70 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
